name: security-sweep
_comment: fan-out-and-synthesize + adversarial verification. One node per file hunting one class of issue; every finding must survive three skeptics before it reaches the report. Replace for_each with your real file list.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: {{task}}

Audit exactly one file: {{item}}
Hunt one class of issue only: missing or bypassable authorization checks.
For each finding return one line:
  <file>:<line> | <one-sentence claim> | <verbatim code quote>
If the file is clean, return the single line: NO FINDINGS.
Do not review any other file.

nodes.reason: opens a pull request against main and notifies the security channel
